chapter: Erroll Garner and the Los Angeles scene
title: Garner remembered; length of the honor farm stay
summary: They joked about it afterwards; about 45 days in total.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: What do you remember about his personal interests and likes and dislikes? Do you remember anything particular about those?
No... I know what he liked. But we don't talk about those things, you know. We were all right. I mean, like, I can't see that he did anything different from anybody else. But he was a lot of fun.
Did you often kind of reminisce about your time together on the honor farm?
Oh, every time we saw each other we'd say, "What time you gonna check in?" Like, we used to have a (?).
How long were at the honor farm, actually?

About I would say 45 days, I think it was -- including all the incarceration of being in jail and staying at one place nine days, then they take you out on the honor farm. That's supposed to be like you're practically out but you're not.
So it was actually about a month at the honor farm, more or less.

Yeah, more or less. About a month and 11 days or something like that. But anyway, we all came out about the same time. But I don't know why they wouldn't let us play together. Because I figured, well, what the hell, I
don't mind going up if Erroll Garner's there. You know, he's somebody to play with. And they wouldn't let us play together. I guess they were supposed to be punishing us or something.
